faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.subtitle: Operational Information
faq.q1: What is the average implementation time?
faq.a1: Our engineering methodology allows for rapid initial deployments, generally between 4 to 12 weeks depending on the complexity and architecture of the required technological solution.
faq.q2: Do you work with legacy systems?
faq.a2: Yes. We perform an initial diagnostic to identify if secure data integration is possible or if we recommend a deep migration toward a modern microservices-based architecture.
faq.q3: Are you a traditional web development agency?
faq.a3: Not at all. Vanta Solutions is an engineering firm focused on the operational core of commercial enterprises. The visual design is solely the frontend of a structurally robust system.
faq.q4: What happens with source code ownership?
faq.a4: Absolute transparency. Once the solution is implemented and settled, the infrastructure, databases, and core code become the full intellectual property of your company.
